class.name: ArkherAutoQuality
class.brief_description: Measures device performance and recommends a rendering quality scale (Arkher pillar 1: "photoreal on any phone").
class.description: This node is part of the Arkher Engine. It measures the current frames per second (exponential moving average) and the low-processor-usage-mode flag, then computes a recommended rendering quality scale between [member min_scale] and [member max_scale], plus a discrete quality tier (0 = low, 1 = medium, 2 = high). [b]The node is advisory:[/b] it never changes rendering on its own. Connect to the [signal quality_changed] signal and apply the recommended scale to dynamic resolution, shadows, global illumination and effect tiers. Example usage (GDScript): [code] auto_quality.quality_changed.connect(func(scale, tier): # scale: 0.5..1.0, tier: 0/1/2 $Light.omni_light_shadow_enabled = tier > 0 end) [/code]

method.name: get_consider_low_processor_usage_mode
method.description: Returns whether low-processor-usage-mode (power saving) forces the recommended scale toward [member min_scale].

method.name: get_current_scale
method.description: Returns the currently recommended rendering quality scale, between [member min_scale] and [member max_scale].

method.name: get_max_scale
method.description: Returns the upper bound of the recommended scale (default 1.0).

method.name: get_measured_fps
method.description: Returns the exponential moving average of measured frames per second (0 before the first frame).

method.name: get_min_scale
method.description: Returns the lower bound of the recommended scale (default 0.5).

method.name: get_smoothing
method.description: Returns the smoothing factor (0..1) applied to the measured FPS before computing the scale.

method.name: get_target_fps
method.description: Returns the target frames per second the device should hold (default 60).

method.name: get_tier
method.description: Returns the discrete quality tier derived from [method get_current_scale]: 0 = low (scale < 0.65), 1 = medium (0.65..0.85), 2 = high (>= 0.85).

method.name: is_enabled
method.description: Returns whether the node is actively measuring and emitting [signal quality_changed].

method.name: set_consider_low_processor_usage_mode
method.description: Sets whether low-processor-usage-mode (power saving) forces the recommended scale toward [member min_scale].

method.name: set_enabled
method.description: Sets whether the node is actively measuring and emitting [signal quality_changed].

method.name: set_max_scale
method.description: Sets the upper bound of the recommended scale.

method.name: set_min_scale
method.description: Sets the lower bound of the recommended scale.

method.name: set_smoothing
method.description: Sets the smoothing factor (0..1) applied to the measured FPS.

method.name: set_target_fps
method.description: Sets the target frames per second the device should hold.

members.member: When the OS is in low-processor-usage mode (power saving), the recommended scale is capped near [member min_scale].
Upper bound of the recommended scale.
Lower bound of the recommended scale.
Smoothing factor (0..1) for the measured FPS.

signal.name: quality_changed
signal.description: Emitted whenever the recommended scale changes. [code]scale[/code] is the continuous recommendation (between [member min_scale] and [member max_scale]) and [code]tier[/code] is the discrete tier (0 = low, 1 = medium, 2 = high).
